title: Simultaneous EEG-SEEG recordings of deep mesial temporal sources (interictal spike epochs)
description: This dataset contains nine simultaneous scalp EEG and stereo-EEG (SEEG) recordings of mesial temporal networks from seven patients with temporal lobe epilepsy. Each recording consists of 1 s epochs centred on the earliest, highest-amplitude interictal intracerebral spikes, with bipolar SEEG channels and 128-channel scalp EEG. In total, 1945 spike epochs are provided, which makes the data suitable for studying how deep mesial temporal sources appear on the scalp.
methods_description: Simultaneous recordings were acquired with a 128-channel system at 512 Hz, with an analog 0.15 Hz high-pass filter and a scalp FPz reference. The earliest, highest-amplitude interictal intracerebral spikes were marked at the peak of the initial component (t0). EEG and SEEG segments are 1 s epochs centred on t0, band-pass filtered at 1.5-30 Hz, with no artifact rejection.
